items.title: Jessie Charles Interview, 1967-12-15
items.q: And we donate our service to George Williams and John Casmick.

ctx.x: I remember one job you played clarinet on because we went a special kind of job to send Kid Sheik off. Yeah, yeah, yeah. And they had a brass band at the train station. Yeah, yeah, yeah.

It's a different kind of job. That's right. That's more of a donation. Like when they play, you know, send guys off or go meet guys like that. But I know that's more of a donation. If you want to go, you know, just donate your service like that. It's okay. Just like a lot of funerals we play. A lot of funerals we play for different members, you know, union guys. It's okay. It's just if you want to donate your service. Yeah, it's okay. Yeah. And we donate our service to George Williams and John Casmick. And it…
Just if you have a good friend and maybe he passed away then for his funeral, you just donate-
